label: Node.js command-line tool
description: A command-line tool in TypeScript on Node.js, with argument parsing, tests and a README.
task: Scaffold a Node.js command-line tool in TypeScript in this empty folder. Create package.json with a bin entry, "type": "module", and the scripts build (tsc), start (run the built CLI) and test (vitest run); tsconfig.json; src/cli.ts that parses its arguments with node:util parseArgs and supports --help and --version; src/index.ts with the tool's logic as plain functions. Set up Vitest with tests for the logic and for --version. Add a .gitignore for node_modules and dist, and a README.md that says what the tool does and how to install, run, test and build it.
